sources.title: Incredible India · Mangalajodi
sources.note: Ecological significance, Birdwatching opportunities and Sustainable tourism initiatives. Supports habitat, winter season and community work; it is not a current bird census or an operator inspection.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism · National Chilika Bird Festival
sources.note: Locates Mangalajodi on Chilika’s northern fringe and describes its community conservation history. A general tourism account, not testimony about any individual resident. No festival dates or booking arrangements are asserted here.

sources.title: American Birding Association · Code of Birding Ethics
sources.note: Sections 1(b), 1(c) and 3: avoid disturbance, use restraint with recordings and respect local rules. General birding guidance, not Odisha legislation.
